decision: Preserve TQP-01 through TQP-43 and reorder all future work around native CPU authority, standalone CPU release, GPU release, and post-release game systems.
alternatives_considered: leave performance, collision, responsiveness, power, and soak combined in one broad milestone
qualify game-oriented destruction and structural systems before releasing the terrain core
begin GPU implementation before a standalone qualified CPU production baseline exists
treat the integration game as the production terrain implementation
create another human roadmap instead of correcting the TQP itself
evidence: TQP-01 through TQP-43 retained status and evidence remain unchanged
the previous TQP-45 mixed scheduler responsiveness, collision policy, rendering, memory, queues, power, and soak into one non-auditable promotion
the previous order placed game systems and GPU work before the standalone production terrain release
the retained low-power profile already requires independent collision demand, frame pacing, edit responsiveness, power, and energy evidence
known downstream failures include delayed digging and construction after fast movement, delayed collision updates, queue disorder, frame-rate pressure, and poor watt-per-60-FPS behavior
qualified_scope: preservation of every retained TQP-01 through TQP-43 status and claim
one human-readable TQP as program authority with machine-readable mirrors
unqualified_scope: TQP-44 through TQP-50 native adaptive-terrain closure
GPU field, meshing, residency, performance, or production release
post-release destruction, structural, world-system, or networking behavior
any current claim of sustained 60 FPS at 16 W
standards_changed: program manifest, qualification state, blockers, suite mirrors, successor milestone references, backend-decision references, and low-power ownership
review: The migration fails closed if any TQP-01 through TQP-43 status or claim changes, if TQP-44 is not the sole recommended next milestone, if IDs are not contiguous through TQP-71, or if a blocked milestone lacks an explicit owner and exit condition.
downstream_impact: TQP-44 remains the next milestone. Gate E now closes at TQP-50; Gate F releases the standalone CPU addon at TQP-57; Gate G releases the GPU backend at TQP-64; game-oriented work starts at TQP-65 and is not required for terrain release.
